description: Small deterministic smoke dataset covering arithmetic, classification, extraction and coding answers. It checks plumbing and answer formats; it is not a benchmark of model intelligence.

cases.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only.
Classify the sentiment of 'The build finally passed, great work!' as positive, negative or neutral. Reply with one word.
Extract the service name and port from: 'The api service listens on port 8173.' Return JSON with fields service and port.
In Python, which built-in function returns the number of items in a list? Reply with the function name.
Text: 'JARVIS records approval requests; approving them executes nothing.' In two words, what does JARVIS record? Reply with those words only.
